On Mon, Feb 9, 2015 at 2:50 AM, Jim <jimc...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi, 

 I was able to run my shiny app locally but I was unable to launch it in browser after successfully deploying the app. Thank you in advance! The Chrome browser frees like this:  




Local working app 



My server.R:
require('rCharts')
require('shiny')
library(lubridate)
library(RPostgreSQL)
library(quantmod)
require(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

      timeInterval<-c("Monthly","Weekly","Daily","Hourly")

sourceData <-reactive({

   drv <- dbDriver("PostgreSQL")
   con <- dbConnect(drv, dbname="dbname", host ="localhost", port=5432)
   on.exit(dbDisconnect(con), add=TRUE)

   ####Some function for accessing the databse#####
})

   #Drop down selection of time interval 
  output$choose_time_interval <- renderUI({
    selectInput("time_interval", "Choose a time interval", as.list(c(timeInterval,"15min")),selected="Daily")
  })

   output$graph <- renderPlot({ 
   #some plot
   })

My ui.R:
require('rCharts')
require('shiny')
library(lubridate)
library(RPostgreSQL)
library(quantmod)
require(zoo)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
 
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel('Dashboard'),
  
  sidebarPanel(
  uiOutput("choose_time_interval")
  ),
  mainPanel(
    plotOutput('graph')
  )
))
